title: Verification - Post-merge full risk scan (deployments / Helm / GitOps)
summary: Evidence report from helm lint plus helm template render of the sports-store chart, listing rendered resources, PASS checks, and seven open risks.

findings.title: ServiceMonitor selectors do not match Service labels
findings.evidence: ServiceMonitor sports-store-gateway matchLabels app.kubernetes.io/name=gateway, but rendered Service/gateway carries app.kubernetes.io/name=sports-store from the shared sports-store.labels helper; applies to all 6 ServiceMonitors so Prometheus scrapes nothing.

findings.title: MongoDB data is emptyDir (no persistence)
findings.evidence: MongoDB renders as a Deployment, datadir volume at /bitnami/mongodb is emptyDir {}, no PVC or volumeClaimTemplate renders; data lost on restart/upgrade/rollback and mongo-init reseeds each start. Violates the brief's persistence requirement.

findings.title: App secrets and Mongo URIs resolve from AWS Secrets Manager at runtime
findings.evidence: SecretStore aws-secrets-manager (provider aws, SecretsManager, us-east-1, serviceAccountRef app-secrets-sa); ServiceAccount app-secrets-sa IRSA role-arn arn:aws:iam::765858872029:role/sports-store-external-secrets-role; ExternalSecret app-secrets-eso -> Secret app-secrets, refreshInterval 1h, remoteRef key sports-store/production with JWT_SECRET and the five *_MONGO_URI properties; mongodb-credentials-eso -> Secret mongodb-credentials. Chart cannot self-verify resolution; failure yields pods not ready and ALB 503.

findings.title: mongo-init ConfigMap renders with no namespace
findings.evidence: mongo-init-configmap.yaml omits namespace: {{ .Values.namespace.name }}; correct under Argo CD destination namespace, lands in default under raw kubectl apply -f without -n. Same class as the previously fixed F3.

findings.title: Metrics endpoint must actually exist on the pods
findings.evidence: ServiceMonitor endpoint port http, path /metrics; gateway container listens on 8080 (Service http 80->8080). Each service image must expose /metrics; relates to open fix/ci-instrumentator PRs in the service repos.

findings.title: Mongo root and user passwords share one source property
findings.evidence: mongodb-credentials-eso maps both mongodb-root-password and mongodb-passwords from the single MONGO_ROOT_PASSWORD property; functional but root equals user password.

findings.title: Argo CD Application name is cloudcart (F2)
findings.evidence: argocd-app.yaml at repo root still has a duplicate name: key so the Application is named cloudcart; out of scope for this render, sync still functions.

verified_pass: [1] helm lint: 1 chart linted, 0 failed (only 'icon is recommended' INFO)
[2] helm template: exit 0, 1519 lines, no stderr, namespace-aware
[4] Namespace consistency across all resources except ConfigMap/mongo-init (R4)
[5] Ingress backend service.name gateway port 80 matches rendered Service/gateway - F3 stays fixed
[8] All 6 app images pinned to 0.1.0-<7char-hash>, MongoDB mongo:8.0, no latest tags - F1 resolved
[9] ESO wiring consistent: app-secrets-eso target Secret app-secrets matches every Deployment secretKeyRef
notes: Manifest-declared DOC accepted as authoritative. Filename carries a date-numeric prefix and the document is decision-adjacent (risk findings with owners), which could read as an ADR under naive heuristics, but the content is verification evidence from a template render - no Context/Decision/Consequences structure, no Status field, nothing locked. Explicit boundary: template render only, nothing applied to a cluster, E2E not verified.
